PR: feat: Add AWSProvider.prefix to aws secrets manager [closed]
## Problem Statement

The `AWSProvider` (https://external-secrets.io/latest/api/spec/) supports a `prefix` field which would adds a prefix to all retrieved values.

However, looking at the code, only the AWS Parameter Store implements this.

## Related Issue

No issue yet, but I can retroactively create one if desired.

## Proposed Changes

This PR updates the AWS Secrets Manager provider to follow similar logic to AWS Parameter Store. The files are generally quite similar, so I pattern matched the implementation.

For the tests, I'm open to feedback on the best approach here. I inserted tests to re-use the existing test loops, and made adjustments where needed. Let me know if there is a better way to do it.

The edited tests pass (via `go test -v ./pkg/provider/aws/secretsmanager`).
Locally `make test` fails on `github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pkg/utils/resolvers`, however this fails on main too. I didn't look into this too much (yet).
